method: Run every TEST at points=16, grid_points=4, repeats=1; scale continuous cap toward 9.5M whole-program NEMU instructions and grid cap by square root; never exceed upstream requested counts; do not pad short tests.
initial_caveat: Initial runner falsely rejected failed=0 markers. Three real cospi-reference failures exposed missing standard C++ long-double math overloads and were fixed by the math compatibility header, not by relaxing thresholds.
final_evidence_note: End-to-end make -C single run-veclibm-accuracy, with ordinary upstream diagnostics restored; only unsupported %L calls suppressed.
short_case_reason: All 53 short cases already retain their entire original small workload: 20 special-value vector tests and 33 strided tests, mostly 30 points, sincosI 8 points, powI 6x7 grid. They are not repeated to manufacture an instruction minimum.
limitations: Counts depend on toolchain, VLEN and NEMU. All quick-profile numerical assertions pass only at the selected points; full original-density execution was not performed.
